description: 기상청_화산재정보 [volcanoes] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기상청. 기상청에서 화산재 정보를 발생할 때 사용하는 메타정보입니다. - COMNOTIAREALOCALNEW: 화산 폭발로 인한 화산재가 대한민국 영토에 영향을 미칠 때 경고나 주의보를 발령할 신규로 정의된 국내 지리적 영역을 나타냅니다. - COMVOLCANOQUARTER: 특정 화산의 활동 상태를... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기상청. Its tags are 화산, 지진, 정보, 화산활동, 화산재. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-10-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
